entries.22952ba837b47272: What runs through the seemingly disparate product lines is the technology of converting the form of electricity. Power semiconductors are the elements themselves that switch the flow of electricity; inverters are devices that use those elements to change motor rotational speed; uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) and power receiving and transforming equipment are these scaled up to facility size; and power generation plants are the facilities on the side that produces electricity. The auditor's report expresses this connection with the phrase 'mainly in the power electronics business'. Vending machines alone appear to be of a different character, but they too are a collection of equipment that cools, heats and counts money, and are made within the same company.

entries.24fa92ff6acd5255: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,227,595 million, up 9.3% from the previous year. Revenue is recognized in two ways: for made-to-order products and construction contracts, revenue is recognized over a period using the method of estimating the progress toward fulfilling the performance obligation, with progress measured as the ratio of costs incurred up to the end of the period to the estimated total cost of the project. On orders, the filing states that “many products are not made to order, so order volumes are not shown by amount or quantity for each segment,” and it shows order volumes by division on a standalone basis for FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD.: for the fiscal year ended March 2026, Energy ¥331.1 billion, Semiconductors ¥187.7 billion, Industry ¥185.2 billion and Food Distribution ¥103.6 billion. entries.41b7c03ebf5872bd: This business makes power semiconductors that switch the flow of electricity or change its voltage. The securities report lists only one product item for this segment, 'industrial and automotive power semiconductors'; compared with the other 3 segments, it has a narrower product range and instead focuses deeply on 1 product. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥234,253 million, segment profit was ¥23,520 million, and the number of employees was 5,822 (excluding 430 temporary employees). Revenue was roughly flat from ¥233,524 million in the prior year, but segment profit fell by ¥13,561 million from ¥37,081 million in the prior year, the only decline in profit among the 4 reportable segments. The company explains that in the industrial field, revenue exceeded the prior year due to increased demand from China and the effect of exchange rates, while in the electrical components field, revenue fell below the prior year due to lower demand for power semiconductors for electrified vehicles (xEV) and the impact of the price revision in the prior year; profit fell below the prior year due to soaring raw material prices, price competition mainly in the Chinese market in the industrial field, and lower demand in the electrical components field. This business also requires large capital investment; the increase in property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of ¥35,389 million and depreciation of ¥39,388 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026 are both the largest among the 4 reportable segments. In the current period, it also recorded impairment losses of ¥2,947 million; the group's total impairment losses consist only of this segment's amount. The orders received by the semiconductor division of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD. on a standalone basis are ¥187.7 billion.

entries.e0391a78888e3040: Its current listing destinations are the 3 exchanges, the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, the Premier Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange, and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange, and the 3 exchanges from 70 years ago continue as they are.
entries.e0c92e6ceb58f04e: This is a business not included in the reportable segments. Note 1 of the securities report states: 'The 'Other' category comprises business segments not included in the reportable segments and includes financial services, real estate, insurance agency, travel, and printing and information services.' The companies responsible are Fuji Electric Fias Co., Ltd. and Fuji Office & Life Service Co., Ltd.; the latter is the successor in form to Fuji Electric Home Appliances Co., Ltd., which was established in October 1966 to strengthen sales in the home appliance division. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥38,154 million, segment profit was ¥3,865 million, and the number of employees was 1,487 (excluding 376 temporary employees). This category has a high proportion of work within the group; intersegment internal revenue or transfers in the same fiscal year amounted to ¥20,203 million. In addition, Metawater Co., Ltd. and Metawater Service Co., Ltd., which are engaged in water treatment, are equity-method affiliates of this segment.
entries.e4a74113a4ed2f92: This field sells components that equipment makers incorporate into their own machines.
entries.eb4c3bd83e5283c4: This field handles power receiving, distribution and control equipment, and was incorporated into Industry in the current segment reorganization. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue rose above the prior year as demand from machinery set makers recovered gradually, and operating profit (loss) also exceeded the prior year, as higher demand and price revisions offset the impact of soaring raw material prices.
entries.ed47e2288d5724af: This field carries out electrical construction and air-conditioning equipment construction works and was incorporated into Energy in the current period's segment reorganization. The work is carried out by a company that became a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange in February 2025 and changed its trade name to Fuji Electric Ｅ＆Ｃ Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit exceeded the prior year due to an increase in large projects, differences in projects, and the promotion of cost reductions.
entries.f3ac5e0bba6c1539: Industry: drive and measurement control systems, FA systems, drive systems and door systems for railway rolling stock, systems for ships and ports, radiation equipment and systems, power distribution and control equipment, ICT-related equipment and software
entries.f4eb3c7e1009049d: Energy: thermal power generation equipment, geothermal power generation equipment, hydroelectric power generation equipment, fuel cells, nuclear-related equipment, power receiving and transforming equipment, industrial power supply equipment, energy storage systems, energy management systems, solar and wind power generation, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), electrical panels, electrical construction and air-conditioning construction
entries.fd5284428ec03627: It is a year in which 2 ways of separating businesses that it does not hold on its own were shown. For water environment, it made it a merged company with another company and had it listed, and the [Business Description] of the securities report lists METAWATER Co., Ltd. and METAWATER Service Co., Ltd. as equity-method companies in the "Other" segment. For power distribution and control equipment, it took the form of partnering with a major overseas company, but this field has now returned to the group's business as the equipment field of the "Industry" segment, and Fuji Electric Device & Control Co., Ltd. is a major consolidated subsidiary in Industry.
